Read this first

People drop a name and a number, pick their own state, and the card grows in batches. Download one state, or the whole file.

Once you've downloaded the file and saved it to your phone's contacts, each and everyone on that contact file will have your number saved automatically and will start viewing your status. You don't have to complain of low views anymore, just register your number, download it, save and enjoy.

MAKE SURE YOU SHARE THE LINK TO MORE PEOPLE SO WE CAN KEEP HAVING MORE PEOPLE ON THE FILE SO YOU CAN HAVE A LOT OF VIEWS.
